mods.name: durability-check
mods.description: Equipment durability tracker: movable panel of worn items with hit points, amber/red bars at warn/danger thresholds, overall %, journal alerts when an item drops a band, hover tooltip, double-click to unequip into the backpack.

mods.name: grid-containers
mods.description: Grid container windows: resizable panel, search and sort, pins, free placement, quick move (Ctrl+click) and multi-move (Shift+drag), plus corpse grid. Replaces the client's classic container windows while on.

mods.name: journal
mods.description: Tabbed, resizable system-log window: All/Sys/Chat/Party/Guild plus custom tabs, hue/hide rules, overhead speech, wheel scrollback, UO fonts, fades in on hover, click-through when idle. Replaces the client's built-in log.

mods.name: legacy-plugins
mods.description: Runs the classic assistant plugins on the new client: packet hooks, hotkeys, walking, spells and abilities. Windows desktop only.

mods.name: nearby-hpbars
mods.description: Nearby mobiles health list: distance, HP % and notoriety colour per row, notoriety filters, follow, and two configurable quick-action buttons per mobile (Bandage, Heal, Greater Heal, Cure, Arch Cure, Remove Curse, Close Wounds, Cleansing Winds) that act on the current target cursor or cast/use directly. Collapsible, resizable, movable window.
